description: The agreement between the backend and the frontend about API errors. The backend tests check that each request body produces this status and code. The frontend tests check that each status and code produces this message for the user. A change on either side that breaks the agreement fails that side's tests.

cases.name: zero raised to a negative power
negative base raised to a fractional power
cases.message: That calculation has no real-number result.

cases.name: square root of a negative number
cases.message: Cannot take the square root of a negative number.

cases.name: result too large
cases.message: The result is too large to calculate.

cases.name: missing operand
cases.message: The calculation could not be processed. Check your input and try again.

cases.name: second operand sent to a one-operand operation
cases.message: The calculation could not be processed. Check your input and try again.
